ml.name: Neitiznot

get_inside.text: Lunar Sea
Players can teleport to the Fremennik Province lodestone, which is just east of Rellekka. From here they can head in to the town and take the boat to Neitiznot (north-east pier).
Players can move their player-owned house to Rellekka, teleport to their house, then go to Neitiznot from there.

get_inside.text: Rellekka Hunter area
The entrance to the dungeon is not marked on either the mini-map or the world map.
There are several fast ways to get to the dungeon:
Flying by polar eagle is the fastest way to reach the dungeon, as the entrance to their lair is directly east of its entrance.
The arctic bear, a familiar available at level 71 Summoning, can teleport the player to the Trollweiss Hunter area.
teleport to Fremennik Province lodestone and head north.

Players can appear near Keldagrim via fairy ring code DKS (called the Kandarin: Snowy Hunter area in the rings' network directory). The Trollweiss Hunter area is north of the ring. Partial completion of the quest A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the rings.

place.title: Rellekka Hunter area dungeon
place.summary: The main chamber is full of aggressive gnoeals that attack with magic and yetis that attack with melee. In this dungeon players can easily be attacked by both combat styles at once. The yetis and gnoeals also attack one another and a pair of fighting monsters will ignore the player if the player leaves them alone. If the player attacks one of a fighting pair, the attacked monster will often (not always) switch opponents and target the player. (This has been confirmed for the yetis but not for either the aggressive or non-aggressive gnoeals. Gnoeals will often switch, however, if the player's familiar attacks it.) Sometimes, a monster attacking the player will switch to attack a monster attacking it, although this does not happen as often.

ml.name: Senntisten Asylum

get_inside.text: Senntisten
Map showing how to get to the Senntisten Asylum from various entry points
pic: Map showing how to get to the Senntisten Asylum from various entry points

get_inside.text: The Senntisten asylum can be entered by operating the asylum elevator to the north-east of Senntisten Cathedral.
Options to reach the asylum include:
Teleport directly into the asylum using the Mask of the Abyss or Helm of Warping.
Teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site, then head north to the elevator.
Using the master archaeologist's outfit teleport
Teleport to the Archaeology Campus using the archaeology journal, then use the dig sites map inside the Archaeology Guild (requires 60 Archaeology)
Teleport to Senntisten using the pontifex shadow ring, then run north-east to the elevator.
Teleport to the TzekHaar Front or the Zamorakian Undercity via War's Retreat or the Max Guild, leave the Senntisten sewers and run north-east to the elevator.
Through Senntisten ancient door, then run to the east. Options to reach the ancient door include:
Teleport to the Varrock Dig Site using the Dig Site pendant or archaeology journal and then run north to the ancient door.
Use Skeletal horror Teleport or Fort Forinthry lodestone to King's Road, then run south-west to the ancient door.
Use an invitation box to teleport to the Empyrean Citadel and again return to the Gielinor surface, then run south-west to the ancient door.

pics: Map showing how to get to the Senntisten Asylum from various entry points

place.title: Senntisten Asylum
place.summary: Between the abyssal savages and abyssal lords is an asylum gate. The gate requires a gate key to unlock that can be obtained as a drop from abyssal lords. Once the gate is unlocked, players can bring a rope to hang from the broken railing to unlock a permanent shortcut to the lords. It is not required to open the door to access the lords as players can simply run around the asylum to reach the area, although it is longer, and players must run through aggressive abyssal beasts.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Senntisten asylum can be entered by operating the asylum elevator to the north-east of Senntisten Cathedral.

Options to reach the asylum include:
• Teleport directly into the asylum using the Mask of the Abyss or Helm of Warping.
• Teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site, then head north to the elevator.
• Using the master archaeologist's outfit teleport
• Teleport to the Archaeology Campus using the archaeology journal, then use the dig sites map inside the Archaeology Guild (requires 60 Archaeology)
• Teleport to Senntisten using the pontifex shadow ring, then run north-east to the elevator.
• Teleport to the TzekHaar Front or the Zamorakian Undercity via War's Retreat or the Max Guild, leave the Senntisten sewers and run north-east to the elevator.
• Through Senntisten ancient door, then run to the east. Options to reach the ancient door include:
• Teleport to the Varrock Dig Site using the Dig Site pendant or archaeology journal and then run north to the ancient door.
• Use Skeletal horror Teleport or Fort Forinthry lodestone to King's Road, then run south-west to the ancient door.
• Use an invitation box to teleport to the Empyrean Citadel and again return to the Gielinor surface, then run south-west to the ancient door.

ml.text: Yk'Lagor the Thunderous is the final Dungeoneering boss monster encountered on the occult floors. He is found on floors 45 to 47 of Daemonheim. A Dungeoneering level of 89 is required to fight him. He is a high-ranking Kal'Gerion demon and one of Kal'Ger the Warmonger's generals.

get_inside.text: Wilderness

Walking through the Wilderness to the east.
War's Retreat Teleport then enter the Shadow Reef boss portal.

ml.name: Temple of Aminishi
ml.text: Yukimura of Hanto is a mini-boss in the Temple of Aminishi and high commander of the forces of Hanto, located in the fourth chamber, just north of the Violet Lotus. Although the miniboss looks virtually identical to the Hanto sellswords, he does not use the spinning blade attack. Instead, he uses standard abilities.

get_inside.text: Aminishi
Complete the quest Impressing the Locals to access the dungeon.
Teleport to Port Sarim and travel to the island of Aminishi by talking to Quartermaster Gully. Run to the main gate of the Temple of Aminishi to the north.
Use the Arc journal to teleport to the island of Aminishi and run to the Temple of Aminishi gate.

Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside the Shadow Reef, the Dragonkin Laboratory, or the Zamorakian Undercity.

place.title: Temple of Aminishi
place.summary: The Temple of Aminishi, also known as ED1 or the Temple of Seiryu, is the first Elite Dungeon, a 1-3 player combat/narrative experience that rewards unique loot and Dungeoneering experience and dungeoneering tokens. The Temple of Aminishi is located on the island of Aminishi and requires completion of Impressing the Locals to access. The grouping system is required in order to form a team of 2-3 players.
